prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished horizontal FOUR-PANEL wordless comic strip, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio, for a lightweight static loading illustration. Exactly black ink and white background, no gray, no color, no gradients. All four panels tell this same sequence left to right: (1) a small beaver tangled in a comically confusing pile of cables, with a cable draped over its head and a puzzled expression; (2) the beaver leaning over an open instruction manual, studying a simple network diagram; (3) a relaxed coffee break, gently holding a tiny steaming mug; (4) actively connecting the cables into a clean network of connected dots, with one last silly loose cable. The beaver must be clearly the SAME recognizable animal across all four scenes, but each pose, silhouette and action must be different. Rounded animal body, very short paws, small ears, rounded muzzle, tiny incisors and a broad flat paddle tail. Cute through appealing proportions and charming acting, not huge anime eyes or a human face. No human hands, no clothes, no human torso or long limbs. Strong visual storytelling, beautiful professional character design, readable when reduced to about 650px wide. Plenty of white breathing room and very simple props. No captions, lettering, logos or watermarks. ART DIRECTION A: Premium hand-crafted 1-bit pixel art as if from a beautifully designed monochrome handheld console game. Deliberately chunky consistent square pixel grid, confident clean silhouettes, extremely restrained interior detail. Tiny dark dot eyes, bean-shaped compact body, a large flat beaver tail. Warmly funny and endearing, with simple expressive postures. Four distinct generously spaced scenes divided by thin pixel vertical separators. White background dominates. Pixel-perfect design feeling, no dithering, no fur texture, no dense crosshatching. Craft this as an excellent indie game artist would, not clip art.
